title: Parallel File Edits in Same Conversation
description: Editing multiple files in parallel using the Edit tool. The Edit tool uses exact string matching for replacements. When multiple files are edited simultaneously, the tool may fail to find exact strings, race conditions can cause partial edits, and error recovery becomes impossible. Files must be edited sequentially — edit file A, wait for confirmation, then edit file B.
example:
// WRONG (parallel edits):
Edit file_a.cpp  // launched simultaneously
Edit file_b.cpp  // launched simultaneously
Edit file_c.cpp  // → failures likely

// CORRECT (sequential edits):
Edit file_a.cpp → wait for confirmation
Edit file_b.cpp → wait for confirmation
Edit file_c.cpp → wait for confirmation
whenToUse: When reviewing any multi-file edit operation. When planning implementation that spans multiple files.
